reason: E1 supports that cubic symmetry limits anisotropy and that Pt addition can promote L10 ordering, but neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence that such ordering actually increases coercivity or domain wall pinning; the coercivity-enhancement premise is unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: High-symmetry cubic lattice limits magnetocrystalline anisotropy in FeCoNiMnCu
Low-symmetry chemical order plus strong spin-orbit coupling enhances magnetocrystalline anisotropy
Adding 50 at.% Pt to FeCoNiMnCu can stabilize a high-entropy L10 phase
L10 ordering increases coercivity via enhanced anisotropy and domain wall pinning
